title: Constructing a nuanced argument / Gargajiya da ra'ayoyi mai matarsa da mai girma
bridge: A cikin turanci, gargajiya da ra'ayoyi mai matarsa na samuwa ne da yawa ta amfani da adabiyoyi masu daraja (misali, 'somewhat', 'arguably'), kalmomi masu yin modal (misali, 'might', 'could'), da kuma yin amfani da kalmomin da ke ba da damar (misali, 'although', 'while'). Da yawa, a turanci ba a yi amfani da subjunctive kamar yadda a cikin turanci, amma a turanci an fi yi amfani da tsarin kalmomi da masu nuna bayanin magana. Kuskure mai yawa shine daidaitawa da sabuwar turanci kamar 'aunque pudiera ser' da ke da sauki a turanci, wanda ke nuna cewa 'although it could be' ko 'while it might be'.
rule: Don Allah ka gina ra'ayoyi mai matarsa a turanci a darajar C1, ka hada: 1) Adabiyoyi masu nuna damar (misali, 'arguably', 'apparently', 'probably') don nuna matsayin mai magana. 2) Kalmomi masu modal (might, may, could) don nuna darajojin tabbatarwa. 3) Kalmomin da ke ba da damar (although, even though, while, whereas) don nuna ra'ayoyi masu daidaituwa. 4) Tsari kamar 'it could be argued that...', 'one might say that...', 'this is not to say that...' don shirya gargajiya. Ka tsaya da tsarin kalmomi: a turanci, gargajiya na iya zo a farkon ko karshen jumla, amma ba a sake farawa da kalmomin da suka dace ba. Ka tsaya da amfani da 'maybe' (mai sauki) a cikin fasaha mai zurfi; ka fi 'perhaps' ko 'possibly'.

concept_examples.text: Although it could be argued that the policy has benefits, its long-term effects remain uncertain.
concept_examples.translation: Da yake muna iya cewa siyasa ta samuwa da fa'ida, amma tasiri ta da yawa a baya ne.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɔːlˈðəʊ ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːɡjuːd ðæt ðə ˈpɒləsi hæz ˈbenɪfɪts, ɪts ˈlɒŋtɜːm ɪˈfekts rɪˈmeɪn ʌnˈsɜːtən/

concept_examples.text: While this approach seems reasonable, one might question its practicality in real-world scenarios.
concept_examples.translation: Da yake wannan tsari ya dace da ra'ayi, wani zai iya yiwa tambaya game da amfani da shi a cikin yanayin duniya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /waɪl ðɪs əˈprəʊʧ siːmz ˈriːzənəbl, wʌn maɪt ˈkwestʃən ɪts ˌpræktɪˈkæləti ɪn rɪəl wɜːld sɪˈnɑːriəʊz/

concept_examples.text: The evidence is compelling; nevertheless, one should not overlook the counterarguments.
concept_examples.translation: An yi bayani mai tsada; amma ba a dace ba da ra'ayoyi masu daidaituwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈevɪdəns ɪz kəmˈpelɪŋ; ˌnevəðəˈles, wʌn ʃʊd nɒt ˌəʊvəˈlʊk ðə ˈkaʊntərˌɑːɡjʊmənts/

concept_examples.text: It could be said that the proposal, though well-intentioned, fails to address the root cause.
concept_examples.translation: Zai iya cewa shawara, da yake da ni'ima, ba ta nuna matsayin sabon sabon.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd bi ˈsed ðæt ðə prəˈpəʊzəl, ðəʊ ˌwelɪnˈtenʃənd, feɪlz tu əˈdres ðə ruːt kɔːz/

common_error.wrong: Although it could be possible, but I doubt it.
common_error.correct: Although it could be possible, I doubt it.
common_error.correct_alt: It could be possible, but I doubt it.
common_error.explanation: A turanci, yana da sauki a yi amfani da 'although... but' don nuna gargajiya, amma ba a yi wannan a turanci ba. Ka yi amfani da wata kawai. Wata kuma, 'aunque' na iya zama 'although'/'though' a farkon, kuma 'but' na iya zama bayan jumla mai matsayin.

examples.original: Arguably, the most significant factor is economic stability.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɑːrɡjuəbli, ðə məʊst sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈfæktə ɪz ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk stəˈbɪləti/
examples.translation: Zai iya cewa abin da ya fi muhimman shine sabon sabon na lafiya.
examples.note: 'Arguably' na iya zo a farkon ko tsakanin komai; daidai da 'za a iya cewa' a turanci.

examples.original: The results are presumably accurate, but we need to verify them.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑː prɪˈzjuːməbli ˈækjʊrət, bʌt wi niːd tu ˈverɪfaɪ ðəm/
examples.translation: An yi bayani da ake tsamman, amma muna bukata a tabbatar da shi.
examples.note: 'Presumably' na nuna nuna nuna da asali; ba a yi amfani da shi da 'probably' ba.

examples.original: Apparently, the committee has reached a consensus.
examples.phonetic: /əˈpærəntli, ðə kəˈmɪti hæz riːʧt ə kənˈsensəs/
examples.translation: Da yake, an yi cikakken cewa an samu ikon.
examples.note: 'Apparently' na nuna cewa wani abu ya dace da asali kamar bayanin da muna da shi.

examples.original: She might have overlooked the details, but the overall conclusion is sound.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt hæv ˌəʊvəˈlʊkt ðə ˈdiːteɪlz, bʌt ði ˈəʊvərɔːl kənˈkluːʒən ɪz saʊnd/
examples.translation: Ta zai iya yin wata kuskure a kan bayanai, amma ra'ayin mai girma ya dace.
examples.note: 'Might have + participle' na nuna damar da yake a baya.

examples.original: The data could be interpreted differently if we change the assumptions.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə kʊd bi ɪnˈtɜːprɪtɪd ˈdɪfrəntli ɪf wi ʧeɪnʤ ði əˈsʌmpʃənz/
examples.translation: Da yake bayanai zai iya fasaha da yawa idan muka canza kalubalen.
examples.note: 'Could' na nuna damar da yake a kan wata halin.

examples.original: The project may succeed if the funding is secured.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɒʤekt meɪ səkˈsiːd ɪf ðə ˈfʌndɪŋ ɪz sɪˈkjʊəd/
examples.translation: Shawara zai iya samun nasara idan an tabbatar da kudaden.
examples.note: 'May' na mai zurfi; a turanci mai magana ya fi yi amfani da 'might' ko 'could'.

examples.original: Even though the plan is flawed, it offers a starting point for discussion.
examples.phonetic: /ˈiːvən ðəʊ ðə plæn ɪz flɔːd, ɪt ˈɒfəz ə ˈstɑːtɪŋ pɔɪnt fɔː dɪˈskʌʃən/
examples.translation: Da yake shawara ya da kuskure, amma yana ba da matsayi na farkon don magana.
examples.note: 'Even though' ya fi daidaito da 'although'.

examples.original: Whereas some experts advocate for reform, others warn against it.
examples.phonetic: /weəˈræz sʌm ˈekspɜːts ˈædvəkeɪt fɔː rɪˈfɔːm, ˈʌðəz wɔːn əˈɡenst ɪt/
examples.translation: Da yake wasu masu ilimi suke yiwa shawara da fasaha, wasu kuma sun yi musu hasara.
examples.note: 'Whereas' na iya zama a cikin jumlar da ke daidaituwa biyu.

examples.original: However compelling the argument may be, we must consider the practical implications.
examples.phonetic: /haʊˈevə kəmˈpelɪŋ ði ˈɑːɡjʊmənt meɪ bi, wi mʌst kənˈsɪdə ðə ˈpræktɪkəl ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃənz/
examples.translation: Da yake ra'ayi ya dace da bayani, muna bukata a ganawa da tasiri masu aiki.
examples.note: Tsari 'However + adjective + subject + verb' don gargajiya.

translations.ha: Gargajiya da ra'ayoyi mai matarsa da mai girma

title: Critical Analysis and Evaluation / Tasirin fasaha da bincike
bridge: A cikin Espanyol, muna nuna binciken fasaha da tsarin kamar 'me parece que', 'es importante señalar' ko subjuntive. A cikin Turanci, wata matsala ce da yawa domin samun damar bayanin damuwa (may, might, could) don samun damuwa, adadadinsu (highly, somewhat, arguably) da tsarin ra'ayin rashin shi (It is worth noting). Wata kuskure ce da yawa ya yi amfani da 'must' don duk wani abu da yake da 'debe ser' a cikin Espanyol, amma a Turanci 'must' yana nufin damuwa mai tsanin rashin shi, ba damuwa ba. Saboda haka, ya kamata ka koyi yadda za ka iya iya matasa rashin shi ba tare da yin rashin shi ba: a Turanci an yi amfani da 'I would argue' a matsakaici da 'I think definitely'.
rule: Don binciken fasaha a Turanci a matakin C1, yi amfani da: 1) Verbs modal don matasa rashin shi: 'must' (damuwa), 'may/might/could' (damuwa), 'can't' (damuwa ba). 2) Adadadinsu: 'highly', 'extremely', 'somewhat', 'arguably', 'undoubtedly'. 3) Tsarin rashin shi: 'It is worth noting that...', 'It could be argued that...', 'The evidence suggests...'. 4) Verbs na ra'ayi: 'I would argue', 'I contend', 'I maintain' (da yawa da 'I think'). 5) Tsarin fasaha: 'however', 'nevertheless', 'whereas'. kada ka yi amfani da 'I think' da yawa a cikin rubutu na fasaha; yi amfani da 'This implies that...' ko 'It could be inferred that...' a matsakaici. Don bincike, yi amfani da 'strengths and weaknesses', 'implications', 'limitations'.

concept_examples.text: While the author makes a compelling case, the argument fails to address the economic implications.
concept_examples.translation: Ko da yake mabudin mai rubutu yana nuna ra'ayin da ya dace, ba zan tattauna matsalolin kasuwanci ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: waɪl ði ˈɔːθər meɪks ə kəmˈpelɪŋ keɪs, ði ˈɑːrɡjumənt feɪlz tə əˈdres ði ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪkl ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃənz

concept_examples.text: It could be argued that the proposed solution is not sustainable in the long term.
concept_examples.translation: Zai iya yin magana cewa sabon wayar ba da dama ba a karshen lokaci.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjud ðæt ðə prəˈpoʊzd səˈluːʃən ɪz nɑːt səˈsteɪnəbl ɪn ðə lɔːŋ tɜːrm

concept_examples.text: The evidence suggests that the policy has had limited impact, if any.
concept_examples.translation: Dokar ya nuna cewa siyasa ta hada da tasiri mai yawa, ko kuma ba ta hada da wata ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈevɪdəns səˈdʒests ðæt ðə ˈpɑːləsi hæz hæd ˈlɪmɪtɪd ˈɪmpækt, ɪf ˈeni

concept_examples.text: One might question the validity of the study, given its small sample size.
concept_examples.translation: Wani zai iya yin tambaya game da fasaha na bincike, saboda matsayin da yake da yawa ne.
concept_examples.phonetic: wʌn maɪt ˈkwestʃən ðə vəˈlɪdəti əv ðə ˈstʌdi, ˈɡɪvən ɪts smɔːl ˈsæmpəl saɪz

common_error.wrong: I think that the author is right, but the article is not good because it doesn't have examples.
common_error.correct: While the author makes a valid point, the article would be stronger if it included concrete examples.
common_error.correct_alt: Although the author's argument is plausible, the lack of specific examples weakens the overall analysis.
common_error.explanation: Maganar Espanyol suna son nuna ra'ayin 'I think' da yin amfani da tsarin rashin shi da yawa. A cikin Turanci na fasaha, ana tsammanin yin amfani da 'would', 'could', 'arguably' da kare da ra'ayin rashin shi kamar 'not good' (da yawa na fasaha ba). Saboda haka, yi amfani da 'while/although' don nuna fasaha da 'would be stronger if' don nuna sabon fasaha.

examples.original: This may not be the most effective approach.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs meɪ nɑːt bi ðə moʊst ɪˈfɛktɪv əˈproʊtʃ
examples.translation: Wannan zai iya ba da dama ba.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'may' don damuwa. Sannan, a cikin Espanyol an yi amfani da subjuntive, amma a Turanci ba.

examples.original: The results could be interpreted in several different ways.
examples.phonetic: ðə rɪˈzʌlts kʊd bi ɪnˈtɜːrprɪtɪd ɪn ˈsɛvərəl ˈdɪfərənt weɪz
examples.translation: Sauraro na iya iya fahimtar da yawa.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'could' a matsakaici da 'can' don matasa rashin shi mai tsanin fasaha.

examples.original: It would seem that the hypothesis lacks sufficient support.
examples.phonetic: ɪt wʊd siːm ðæt ðə haɪˈpɑːθəsɪs læks səˈfɪʃənt səˈpɔːrt
examples.translation: Ya iya zama cewa nazariya ba da damar da yawa ba.
examples.note: Tsarin 'It would seem that' ya fi fasaha da yin rashin shi da 'it seems'.

examples.original: The argument is compelling, yet it overlooks crucial evidence.
examples.phonetic: ði ˈɑːrɡjumənt ɪz kəmˈpɛlɪŋ, jɛt ɪt ˌoʊvərˈlʊks ˈkruːʃəl ˈɛvɪdəns
examples.translation: Ra'ayin ya dace, amma ya tsallake dalilai masu muhimman.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'yet' a matsakaici da 'but' don fasaha mai tsanin.

examples.original: This approach has significant limitations, particularly in terms of scalability.
examples.phonetic: ðɪs əˈproʊtʃ hæz sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˌlɪmɪˈteɪʃənz, pərˈtɪkjʊlərli ɪn tɜːrmz əv ˌskeɪləˈbɪləti
examples.translation: Wannan fasaha ta da matuƙar matuƙar matuƙar, saboda haka, ba ta da damar da yawa a matsayin sabon fasaha.
examples.note: Koyi tsarin da yawa: 'significant limitations', 'key weaknesses', 'notable strengths'.

examples.original: The research is groundbreaking, but its scope is rather narrow.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈriːsɜːrtʃ ɪz ˈɡraʊndbreɪkɪŋ, bʌt ɪts skoʊp ɪz ˈræðər ˈnæroʊ
examples.translation: Bincike ya fi fasaha, amma matsayin da yake da yawa ne.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'rather' a matsakaici da 'muy' don matasa rashin shi.

levels.label: Arguing and Counterarguing
levels.translation: Yin magana da magana da magana

examples.original: While I concede that the data is limited, I maintain that the pattern is still relevant.
examples.phonetic: hwaɪl aɪ kənˈsiːd ðæt ðə ˈdætə ɪz ˈlɪmɪtɪd, aɪ meɪnˈteɪn ðæt ðə ˈpætərn ɪz stɪl ˈrɛləvənt
examples.translation: Ko da na yarda cewa dalilai suna da matuƙar matuƙar, ina tsammanin fasaha ta fi damar da yawa.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'while' a farko don yarda da ra'ayi, sannan ka nuna ra'ayinka da 'I maintain'.

examples.original: It could be argued that the policy is outdated; however, it still provides a useful framework.
examples.phonetic: ɪt kʊd bi ˈɑːrɡjud ðæt ðə ˈpɑːləsi ɪz ˌaʊtˈdeɪtɪd; haʊˈɛvər, ɪt stɪl prəˈvaɪdz ə ˈjuːsfəl ˈfreɪmwɜːrk
examples.translation: Zai iya yin magana cewa siyasa ta yi da yawa; saboda haka, tana ba da tsarin da ya dace.
examples.note: Haɗa 'It could be argued that' da 'however' don nuna magana da magana.

examples.original: Despite the opposition, the proposal merits serious consideration.
examples.phonetic: dɪˈspaɪt ði ˌɑːpəˈzɪʃən, ðə prəˈpoʊzəl ˈmɛrɪts ˈsɪriəs kənˌsɪdəˈreɪʃən
examples.translation: Ko da yake da rashin amfani, sabon fasaha ya dace da yin bincike mai muhimman.
examples.note: Koyi yadda za ka yi amfani da 'despite + noun' (ba 'despite of').

title: Irony and Understatement / Ironiya, sarcasm da eufemism
bridge: A cikin Ingilishi, ironiya da sarcasm suna nuna da yawa da fasaha ko tsarin da ke da wata matsala (misali, 'claro', 'por supuesto', 'como no'), kuma koyaushe ake amfani da yawan ko kwararrarewa. A cikin Ingilishi, ironiya na iya zama da fasaha da yawa da fasaha ko tsarin da ke da wata matsala (misali, 'claro', 'por supuesto', 'como no'), kuma koyaushe ake amfani da yawan ko kwararrarewa. A cikin Ingilishi, ironiya na iya zama da fasaha da yawa da fasaha ko tsarin da ke da wata matsala. A cikin Ingilishi, 'understatement' (yawan da ba da gaske) shine wata fasaha mai mahimmanci don nuna ironiya (in da 'not bad' don nuna 'excelente'), wanda yake da wata matsala ga wadanda suka yi Ingilishi, wanda ke da wata matsala ga wadanda suka yi Ingilishi. Wata fasaha mai mahimmanci ita ce, sarcasm a cikin Ingilishi zai iya zama mai wahala fiye da wata cikin Sipanyol, saboda zai iya zama mai wahala fiye da wata cikin Sipanyol.
rule: A cikin Ingilishi na C1, ironiya da eufemism suna nuna da: 1) Understatement: yin amfani da adjective ko adverb mai daraja mai yawa don nuna wata matsala (misali, 'It's not the worst idea' = 'wata idea mai kyau da yawa'; 'a bit' ko 'slightly' da ma'ana mai jituwa). 2) Sarcasm: yana daidai da fasaha da fasaha (tsawo ko mai girma), amma kuma da tsarin kamar 'Oh, great!', 'Well, that's just perfect' ko 'I love it when...'. 3) Eufemism: musamman da yadda ake magana (misali, 'passed away' don 'died', 'let go' don 'fired', 'between jobs' don 'unemployed', 'full-figured' don 'fat'). Tsarin da ke da fasaha: adverb mai daraja ('hardly', 'barely', 'scarcely') don understatement; tambaya mai fasaha ('Is that so?') don ironiya; tsarin da ke da 'just', 'only', 'a bit' kamar wata fasaha. Kuskure: ba duka fasaha suka dace da ironiya; a cikin fasaha mai girma, sarcasm mai tsawon ba zai dace ba. Eufemism zai iya canzawa da fasaha ko fasaha. Don sabis na Sipanyol: kada ka yi fasaha na 'no está mal' (ba zai dace a cikin Ingilishi ba, zai iya zama fasaha mai tsawon), kuma yi amfani da 'not too bad' ko 'not bad at all' da fasaha mai dace.

concept_examples.text: That's a bit of an exaggeration, don't you think?
concept_examples.translation: Wannan ya fi girma da yawa, ba ka yarda?
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə bɪt əv ən ɪɡˌzædʒəˈreɪʃən, doʊnt juː θɪŋk/

concept_examples.text: The weather is not exactly tropical here.
concept_examples.translation: Yanke nan ba ne mai haske da yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈweðər ɪz nɒt ɪɡˈzæktli ˈtrɒpɪkəl hɪər/

concept_examples.text: He's been known to stretch the truth occasionally.
concept_examples.translation: Ana sani ne ya yi rashin gaskiya da yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiːz biːn noʊn tə strɛtʃ ðə truːθ əˈkeɪʒənəli/

concept_examples.translation: Yaushe, wannan ya fi girma da yawa! (ironiya)

common_error.wrong: No está mal, ¿eh? (como respuesta a algo excelente, literal translation)
common_error.explanation: Sabbin wata matsala ita ce fasaha na 'no está mal' daga Sipanyol. A cikin Sipanyol, 'no está mal' zai iya nuna abin da ya fi kyau ko abin da ba da kyau ba, amma a cikin Ingilishi 'not bad' ko 'not bad at all' ya kamata ya nuna abin da ya fi kyau. Don nuna understatement mai kyau, ya kamata a saka 'at all' ko yi amfani da 'not half bad' wanda ya nuna 'very good'. Kuma, lura da fasaha: a cikin Ingilishi, koyaushe ake amfani da fasaha mai tsawon ko mai girma don nuna ironiya.

levels.label: Understatement with adverbs of degree
levels.translation: Yawan da ba da gaske da adverb mai daraja

examples.original: I'm a bit confused about the instructions.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ə bɪt kənˈfjuːzd əˈbaʊt ði ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz/
examples.translation: Na yi wata matsala da shawara.
examples.note: A nan 'a bit' ya yi fasaha don neman bayani, amma a cikin wata fasaha za'a iya amfani da shi don ironiya.

examples.original: It's a bit chilly today, isn't it? (said in a blizzard)
examples.phonetic: /ɪts ə bɪt ˈtʃɪli təˈdeɪ, ˈɪzənt ɪt/
examples.translation: Yake da wata matsala da yawa yau, ba ne? (da fasaha a cikin wata yunwa)
examples.note: Amfani da 'a bit' don nuna matsalar da yawa a cikin wata fasaha.

examples.original: She's not exactly the most organized person.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiːz nɒt ɪɡˈzæktli ðə moʊst ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd ˈpɜːrsən/
examples.translation: Ba ta ne mai tsarawa da yawa.
examples.note: 'Not exactly' wata fasaha ce don nuna cewa ta fi tsarawa da yawa.

examples.original: Oh, great. Another meeting on Monday morning.
examples.phonetic: /oʊ, ɡreɪt. əˈnʌðər ˈmiːtɪŋ ɒn ˈmʌndeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Oh, mai kyau! Wata taron da yaushe a ranar Litinin da safe.
examples.note: Sarcasm ya nuna da 'great' da fasaha mai tsawon. Ko da yaushe, zai iya zama mai kyau.

examples.original: Do you mind? I'm trying to work here.
examples.phonetic: /duː juː maɪnd? aɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ tə wɜːrk hɪər/
examples.translation: Kuna da wahala? Na yi aiki a nan.
examples.note: Tambaya mai fasaha wanda ya nuna damuwa, ba tambaya ce.

examples.original: Well, that's just perfect. My car broke down again.
examples.phonetic: /wɛl, ðæts dʒʌst pərˈfɛkt. maɪ kɑːr broʊk daʊn əˈɡen/
examples.translation: Yaushe, wannan ya fi girma da yawa. Na yi wata matsala da motarsa.
examples.note: Amfani da 'perfect' don nuna matsala.

levels.label: Euphemisms for sensitive topics
levels.translation: Eufemism don wata matsala mai haske

examples.original: He's between jobs at the moment.
examples.phonetic: /hiːz bɪˈtwiːn dʒɑːbz æt ðə ˈmoʊmənt/
examples.translation: Yana cikin tsawon aiki a yanzu.
examples.note: Eufemism mai yawa don 'unemployed' a cikin fasaha mai girma.

examples.original: She's had some cosmetic adjustments.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiːz hæd sʌm kɒzˈmɛtɪk əˈdʒʌstmənts/
examples.translation: Ta yi wata fasaha mai haske da fasaha.
examples.note: Eufemism don fasaha mai haske, ko da yaushe ake amfani da fasaha.

examples.original: He passed away peacefully in his sleep.
examples.phonetic: /hiː pæst əˈweɪ ˈpiːsfəli ɪn hɪz sliːp/
examples.translation: Ya mutu da yawa a cikin kwanciya.
examples.note: 'Pass away' eufemism ne mai yawa don 'died'.

examples.original: We had to let go of a few employees last quarter.
examples.phonetic: /wiː hæd tə lɛt ɡoʊ əv ə fjuː ɪmˈplɔɪiːz læst ˈkwɔːrtər/
examples.translation: Muna da wata matsala da yawa a cikin shekaru da dama.
examples.note: 'Let go' yana nuna rashin aiki, saboda fasaha mai girma.
